scripts.check: pnpm run node:check && pnpm --dir packages/ui run check && pnpm --dir apps/hub run check
scripts.test:core: pnpm run node:check && pnpm run check && pnpm --dir packages/ui run test && pnpm --dir apps/hub run test:unit && pnpm --dir apps/hub run test:core && node --test tests/dependency-sweep.test.ts tests/deploy-health-probe-script.test.ts tests/deployment-runtime-guardrails.test.ts tests/direct-execution-guard.test.ts tests/gitignore.test.ts tests/hub-env-example.test.ts tests/hub-node-server-port-validation.test.ts tests/hub-node-server-static-assets.test.ts tests/hub-node-server.test.ts tests/node-version-alignment.test.ts tests/pnpm-audit-gate.test.ts tests/production-image-smoke-build-script.test.ts
scripts.test:build:hub: pnpm run node:check && pnpm --dir apps/hub run test:build
scripts.test:preview:hub: pnpm run node:check && pnpm --dir apps/hub run test:preview
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run node:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test:core
scripts.test:full: pnpm run test:fast && pnpm run test:build:hub && pnpm run test:preview:hub && pnpm run test:production && pnpm run test:integration && pnpm run audit:deps
scripts.test:production: pnpm run node:check && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/docker-build-context.test.ts tests/production-image-smoke-build.integration.test.ts && pnpm --dir apps/hub run test:production
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run node:check && pnpm --dir apps/hub run test:integration
